allies.rationale_text: Narratives helps persuasion-principles bind an idea to emotion and memory so it can travel farther than raw logic alone.
allies.affinity_rationale: Canonical: 'Stories are the single most powerful way to activate the brain and integrate emotion with logical arguments' — fundamental persuasion tool.
allies.activation_condition: When emotional resonance and memorability are needed to make ideas stick with the audience.

allies.rationale_text: Empathy helps persuasion-principles tune the message to what the audience actually cares about rather than to what the expert wants to say.
allies.source_quote: Perspective taking is vital for crafting messages that resonate
allies.affinity_rationale: Canonical: 'Understanding the audience's motives and feelings (Theory of Mind) is crucial for packaging the message correctly' — essential for resonance.
allies.activation_condition: When crafting messages requires deep understanding of the audience's motives, fears, and desires.

antagonists.rationale_text: Critical-thinking slows persuasion-principles down by asking whether the message is merely effective or actually well grounded.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Canonical: 'Persuasion aims for fast, automatic compliance (System 1). Critical thinking requires slow, deliberate evaluation of evidence and assumptions' — structural opposition.
antagonists.activation_condition: When deliberate System 2 analysis would reveal persuasive framing as manipulative or logically weak.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Persuasion-principles conflicts with intellectual-humility when persuasion techniques exploit cognitive shortcuts that override genuine evidence evaluation.
structured_tensions.source_quote: persuasion-principles conflicts with intellectual-humility (intellectual humility) when persuasion techniques exploit cognitive shortcuts that override genuine evidence evaluation.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Persuasion-principles conflicts with authenticity when strategic framing of a message compromises the transparency required for durable trust.
structured_tensions.source_quote: persuasion-principles conflicts with authenticity (authenticity) when strategic framing of a message compromises the transparency required for durable trust.

curation_notes.summary: Layer 1+2 enrichment complete. Both allies at 0.90 (narratives 'most powerful', empathy 'crucial'). critical-thinking antagonist at 0.90 (System 1 vs System 2 opposition). Canonical also lists cognitive-load-theory and pyramid-principle as allies.
donor_drops: Did not manufacture structured tensions because the raw file is rich in allies and antagonists but not in explicit named tension blocks.
open_questions: Cognitive-load-theory is a source-real ally too, but narratives and empathy were the more central operational anchors.

SPARSE_ALLY_RECOVERY: 2 curated allies. Canonical allies include cognitive-load-theory (simplify to reduce audience effort), latticework-of-mental-models (broad knowledge base for finding right frames).
